claim: The Cyber Kill Chain is the model Hutchins et al. define (cited as what the baseline attacker's procedure is modelled on)
quote: The intrusion kill chain is defined as reconnaissance, weaponization, delivery, exploitation, installation, command and control (C2), and actions on objectives.
issue: Hutchins only identifies the model; that the baseline's six attack actions are 'modelled on' it rests on brown2023. The six actions (all reconnaissance, exploitation and credential steps) do not map onto the seven phases, so the co-cite must not be read as Hutchins licensing the six-step procedure.
